online_writes.text: Tessane dispatch agents may call the Corvio carrier-rates API at most 80 requests per second.
online_writes.why: Corvio confirmed the contract upgrade to the 80 req/s tier

online_writes.text: Tessane dispatch agents cache carrier quotes for 120 seconds.
online_writes.why: quotes went stale during the fuel-price surge

outbox.text: Tessane dispatch agents may call the Corvio carrier-rates API at most 40 requests per second.
outbox.why: Corvio returned 429s to the EU agents

outbox.text: Tessane dispatch agents retry a failed carrier webhook 5 times before paging on-call.
outbox.why: the EU carrier webhook endpoint kept flapping

outbox.text: Tessane dispatch agents cache carrier quotes for 600 seconds.
outbox.why: fewer quote calls under the lower rate limit

outbox.text: When the primary payment gateway fails, Tessane dispatch agents fail over to Paymora.
outbox.why: Kelpay announced an EU outage window

A.title: A · replay as-is
A.how: eu-west sends its outbox exactly as it was journaled: one `fact update` per entry, in order. This is what a queue that just drains on reconnect does.

B.title: B · replay as new facts
B.how: eu-west adds each outbox entry as a new fact (`fact add`) instead of overwriting, so MemoryLake's conflict detection can compare it with what is there — the page's "surface for review".

C.title: C · replay only if unchanged
C.how: Each outbox entry carries the fact's `updated_at` and text as eu-west read them. On reconnect: `fact get`; same `updated_at` → `fact update`, then `fact trace` must show it replaced exactly that text; changed → hold the entry for review.
